description: Ministry of Sports - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1986/2 of 26.09.2016 that published the Service Minute of the Department of Sports Development
categorisation: This gazette contains amendments to the Service Minute (regulations) for officers in the Department of Sports Development, detailing their service conditions, salary scales, absorption procedures, promotion examinations, and specific job duties. This content falls under public sector administration, specifically covering service conditions and regulations for public officers, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes).
